AnswerFeedback.description:
What the grader said, across every grader.

One model rather than a union: the deterministic and semantic graders answer
different questions about the same attempt, and a client rendering feedback
should not have to know which one ran.
AnswerFeedback.title: AnswerFeedback

CalibrationOut.description: How honest the system's own numbers have been.
CalibrationOut.title: CalibrationOut

ConceptStatus.description:
A concept seen once with low confidence is noise, not knowledge.

Candidates stay hidden until corroborated: a graph full of one-off extraction
artefacts is worse than a small one, because the user stops trusting all of it.
ConceptStatus.title: ConceptStatus

ConnectionOut.description:
What the API sees of your request, for calibrating the rate limiter.

Authenticated, and about the caller's own connection only. `NOEMA_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS`
has to match the deployment's actual proxy chain, and the number is not
knowable from documentation — hosts add and remove hops. Guessing it wrong
fails silently: the limit simply never bites, which is the failure mode this
endpoint exists to end.
ConnectionOut.title: ConnectionOut

CredentialCreate.description: Write-only. There is deliberately no response model containing ``api_key``.
CredentialCreate.title: CredentialCreate

IntervalPreview.description: What each answer would cost in time before the card returns.
IntervalPreview.title: IntervalPreview

MasteryComponents.description:
The engine's working, declared rather than shipped as an untyped dict.

A consumer reading `components["competence"]` has no way to know that key
exists until it does not.
MasteryComponents.title: MasteryComponents

QuestionPayload.description:
Everything needed to *ask* a question, and nothing that answers it.

Declared rather than left as a dict so a client can see which fields a given
type carries — and so removing one is a visible change to the contract rather
than a key that silently stops appearing.
QuestionPayload.title: QuestionPayload

info.description:
NOEMA — open-source adaptive learning platform.

Cookie sessions authenticate the web app; mutations require the CSRF token returned
at login in the `x-csrf-token` header.
info.title: NOEMA API

post.description:
Stream a tutor reply as Server-Sent Events.

With a notebook, the reply is grounded: chunks are retrieved, numbered into the
prompt, and every citation is validated on the way out. Without one, it is an
ordinary tutor conversation.

schema.title: Response List Credentials Api V1 Ai Credentials Get
Response List Providers Api V1 Ai Providers Get
Response Usage Api V1 Ai Usage Get

get.description:
Whether the system's own predictions have been honest.

Published rather than kept internal on purpose: a tool that tells you when to
study should be able to show whether it has been right.

post.description:
Fit the memory model to this learner's own review history.

The default parameters were fitted on a large public dataset. They are a good
prior and they are not you. This searches for better ones on the earlier half
of your history and judges them on the later half, adopting them only if they
win on reviews the search never saw.
Grade an answer and record it as evidence.

get.description:
List cards.

``due=true`` is the study queue: approved, unsuspended, and either never seen or
past its due date, oldest first so the most overdue is answered first.

schema.title: Response List Cards Api V1 Cards Get

post.description:
Turn one passage into one card per deletion.

Separate rows rather than one card with several blanks: each deletion gets its
own schedule, because recalling one says nothing about the others and pairing
them lets a known half carry an unknown one indefinitely.

schema.title: Response Create Cloze Api V1 Cards Cloze Post

post.description:
Draft cards from a notebook's material.

They arrive unapproved. Nothing generated enters the rotation until a human has
read it — spaced repetition is very good at making a wrong card permanent.

schema.title: Response Generate Api V1 Cards Generate Post

get.description:
List concepts.

Candidates are included only when explicitly asked for: an unproven concept in
the default view is noise the user has to mentally filter every time.

schema.title: Response List Concepts Api V1 Concepts Get

post.description:
Fold concepts into one, keeping their provenance and their edges.

The sources are marked merged rather than deleted, so a wrong merge can be
understood after the fact instead of leaving a hole where a concept was.

get.description:
The neighbourhood around a concept, for the visualiser.

Bounded by depth rather than returning the workspace: a graph view that renders
everything is a hairball nobody can read.

post.description:
Sit an exam over one notebook.

The questions are fixed here and the clock starts here, so reloading the page
does not hand out a fresh, easier paper.
Hand in the paper. Everything is graded at once, and only now.

Feynman mode: explain a concept and be told what the explanation is missing.

Judged against the learner's own material rather than the model's knowledge,
and recorded as evidence — explaining unaided is the hardest retrieval there
is, so it should move the number.

get.description: Soonest first — a deadline further away is not the one to look at.

schema.title: Response List Goals Api V1 Goals Get

post.description:
Set something to know by a date.

The path is not stored with it: it is recomputed on every read, because a plan
pinned at creation describes a learner who no longer exists by Wednesday.
Import an Anki `.apkg` into a notebook, keeping its review history.

get.description:
What the next ``minutes`` should contain, and why.

The user does not choose what to study — the engine decides from mastery,
forgetting, prerequisites and recent mistakes, and explains itself.

post.description:
Build a plan and store it.

The plan is kept verbatim so a later scheduler change can be replayed against
what this one actually decided.
Record what actually happened, which is the other half of the comparison.

get.description: Mastery per concept, with the terms that produced each number.

schema.title: Response Mastery Api V1 Mastery Get

delete.description:
Delete this account.

The session ends immediately and the account stops working now; the data is
purged after a grace period so a decision made at 2am can be undone. Export
first — after the purge there is nothing to recover.

get.description: Show how this request arrived, so the hop count can be set from evidence.

post.description:
Download everything this account owns.

Notes as Markdown, uploads unchanged, structure as JSON — an archive that is
useful without NOEMA.

get.description:
The mistake bank.

Misconceptions first: a confident wrong answer is the failure spaced repetition
never catches, because the learner has no reason to flag it for review.

schema.title: Response List Mistakes Api V1 Mistakes Get

post.description:
Write questions that break the belief behind a confident wrong answer.

Not the same question again: someone holding a coherent wrong model answers
it the same way, and learns that one question rather than changing the model.

schema.title: Response List Questions Api V1 Questions Get
Response Generate Quiz Api V1 Questions Generate Post

get.description:
One question, without its answer.

The mistake bank needs this: it stores question ids, and re-asking one is the
only thing that turns a list of failures into practice.

post.description:
Flush a queue of reviews taken offline.

Applied in order, because each one's interval depends on the state the previous
one left behind.

schema.title: Response Submit Reviews Api V1 Reviews Batch Post

get.description: Upcoming workload, so a learner can see a wall before they hit it.

schema.title: Response Forecast Api V1 Reviews Forecast Get

get.description:
Hybrid search across a user's material.

Same retrieval path the tutor uses, so what search surfaces and what the tutor
can cite never drift apart.

schema.title: Response Search Api V1 Search Get

post.description:
One turn of a Socratic dialogue: the next question, or the verdict.

Unlike the tutor's Socratic mode this one concludes and records what was
reached, because arriving at an idea under questioning is something the
learner did.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api V1 Sources Get

post.description: Validate, store and queue a file for ingestion.

delete.description:
Soft-delete the row and hard-delete the file.

Chunks and embeddings cascade. The stored file goes immediately — keeping a
user's PDF around after they deleted it is not a feature.

get.description:
Per-stage ingestion progress.

Polling the row rather than subscribing to the broker: the status is already
durable, and a client that reconnects gets the current state instead of having
missed the events it was away for.

post.description: Queue the pipeline. Idempotent while a run is already in flight.

get.description:
Readiness reports each dependency separately.

A single boolean tells an operator that something is wrong but not what, which is
the least useful moment to be vague.
